movelist.name: False Swipe
movelist.effect: False Swipe’s damage cannot bring a target lower than 1 Hit Point.

movelist.name: Air Cutter
movelist.effect: Air Cutter is a Critical Hit on 18+.

movelist.name: Fury Cutter
movelist.effect: If Fury Cutter is used successfully and consecutively on the same target, the Damage Base is increased by +4 to a maximum of 16. For example, the first hit would have a DB of 4; the second hit a DB of 8; the third hit a DB of 12; the fourth and further hits a DB of 16. If Fury Cuter misses or fails to damage its target, its Damage Base resets.

movelist.name: Razor Leaf
movelist.effect: Razor Leaf is a Critical Hit on 18+.

movelist.name: Cut
movelist.effect: Cut ignores up to 5 Damage Reduction (Defenses are not Damage Reduction).

abilities.name: Beast Boost
abilities.effect: The user receives +1 Combat Stage in their highest non-HP stat.

abilities.name: Technician
abilities.effect: Moves with a Damage Base of 6 or lower have their Damage Base increased by +2. This bonus always applies to Moves with the Double Strike or Fivestrike Keywords.
